preservation.method: Installed image tool generated a bowl insert; white removed in memory and earth pigments blended onto vacant rock. All other pixels retained exactly.

visual_review: Full PNG and 512px JPEG inspected. Small ochre bowl with three charcoal pebbles added on vacant lower rock. Central Pepe retains broad mouth and heavy-lidded eyes. Inherited hands and hand stencil retain five digits (four fingers and thumb); no new hands. All ancestor marks remain, with exact pixels outside the patch. No letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, borders, real people or prohibited symbols seen.
limitations: Inherited rock has photographic-looking texture, preserved as required.
Visual review is local, not independent certification.
